title: Survey Twilight Caverns
briefing: Map the cavern threshold where the last daylight fades. Clear stalkers from a vent site and establish a forward light marker.
fieldGuide: Mid-depth exploration mission in the Deep Reach campaign.

objectives.label: Enter the Twilight Caverns
objectives.detail: Cross into the dim biome where the stalkers hunt.

objectives.label: Cull Twilight Stalkers
objectives.detail: Eliminate threats around the survey point.

objectives.label: Place a Forward Thermal Vent
objectives.detail: Mark the cavern route with a vent beacon for safe return.

rewards.label: Lattice Crystal
rewards.detail: Strange resonant crystal common in deeper ruins.

rewards.label: Abyssal Stone
rewards.detail: Dense stone used for pressure-resistant construction.

completionText: Twilight Caverns surveyed and a forward vent is burning. The route deeper is marked.
